name: chumz-ari-app
description: Real-time call-control app for the self-hosted Asterisk box (sip.chumz.online). Runs on the Asterisk VPS itself, not DigitalOcean App Platform (where the main dashboard app runs) — connects to ARI over localhost and to Supabase over HTTPS for the same agents/ivr_config/call_logs data the main app uses.
